name: sign-in-approve
title: Sign-in Approve
description: Sign-in approval prompt with no one-tap Approve: the user types the number from the sign-in screen, sees location and device, is warned about request bursts and "support" asking for codes, and every denial ends on a secure-my-account step.

meta.stops: Helps prevent approving an attacker's sign-in through push fatigue
meta.summary: Replaces one-tap sign-in approval with typing the number shown on the sign-in screen, to make MFA-fatigue approvals harder.
meta.server: Verify the number, enforce attempts and expiry, and rate-limit push requests on the server; deny means kill the pending session.
catches: Approvals without seeing the sign-in screen (number matching)
Unusual locations far from normal sign-ins
Bursts of requests in the last 15 minutes
Someone claiming to be support asking for the number
limits: Number checking and attempt limits run through your onApprove; the server must enforce them
Does not send or create the request
a11y: Section labelled by its title; details in a <dl>
Focus moves to the number input on open and to the result (role=status) when finished
Unusual location shown with an icon and text
